task_physics.drag_source: Uncalibrated assumption consistent with existing ShuttlecockParams: 0.5 * 1.225 * 0.12 * 0.0018 / 0.0052
task_physics.ccd_limitation: Isaac Sim 5.1 GPU dynamics disables sweep CCD; neither CCD flag is relied on. Use fine native substeps plus an independent moving/rotating sweep audit. Coarser 2/1 ms settings demonstrably tunnel and are invalid for ball tasks.
task_physics.collision_response: PhysX only, no custom collision impulse or ball pose correction
task_physics.note: Parameters are simulation assumptions. The actual blade geometry and mass remain the G01-audited asset.

task_court.post_position_assumption: Inner post surfaces meet net ends at doubles outer boundaries ±3.05; supports do not protrude into court.
task_court.coordinate_convention: Each environment local x increases from own to opponent; world coordinates=env_origin+local exactly once. Court outer boundaries include painted lines. Z=0 floor.
simplifications: Rigid equivalent net membrane with correct suspended band extent; no cloth dynamics or mesh holes
Sag approximated by64 box strips; exact center/post heights, at most1.7mm deviation from the descriptive parabola; scoring/visualization use the actual strip tops
No opponent agent; body/fixture must remain own half as a separately labelled engineering safety constraint
Shuttle physics remains a declared5.2g rigid surrogate; no claim of real-shuttle aerodynamics or tournament certification
task_court.net_profile_shape: 64 primitive-box strips approximating sag; exact center/post heights and constant0.76m vertical depth
task_court.net_collision_revision_reason: Previous convex-mesh band failed actual robot contact positive fixtures while posts responded; failed records retained.

unrealized_takeoff_requirements.reason: Height is a necessary lower bound; other minimum changes cannot be inferred from a local failed solve.
